タイトル: Sophisticated software without the usual complexity
投稿者: Dustin アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Sophisticated software without the usual complexity"
良い点: Elegant interface, unusually strong guest communication, sophisticated automation, and integrations that feel coherent rather than bolted on. The team is also notably responsive and technically fluent.
改善点: A handful of highly specialized workflows could use slightly more configurability, but the team seems responsive in improving the product with anything that I have brought to them.

タイトル: Can't recommend Hospitable enough - ideal for most small to medium size STR operators
投稿者: Daniel アメリカのOwner operator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Can't recommend Hospitable enough - ideal for most small to medium size STR operators"
良い点: Extremely intuitive for someone not technically savvy and functionality and reliability are top notch. It is great software both via the app and the website. Customer service is excellent and rarely needed.
改善点: I've had very few complaints and can't think of anything overarching to warn someone about. I guess part of its ease of use is that it focuses on the most needed functionality for someone operating a property, but doesn't necessarily give you all the bells and whistles that more expensive software might offer.

タイトル: Easy to Use and Feature-Rich, but Human Support Is Slow
投稿者: Megan アメリカのManaging Owner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy to Use and Feature-Rich, but Human Support Is Slow"
良い点: Hospitable is ever expanding, adding new AI-forward, and admin-reducing features that make life easier.
改善点: Human support is incredibly hard to reach. There is no phone support. And while they offer help articles and AI-chat, if you need a person, you have to wait at least two days, which is ridiculous.

タイトル: Phenomenal - I have tried it all - finally a company that deserves 5 stars in so many ways
投稿者: Jonathan アメリカのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Phenomenal - I have tried it all - finally a company that deserves 5 stars in so many ways"
良い点: - $7/listing - No setup costs - Enabled automation of 90% of my communications - I can review communications that are scheduled automatically BEFORE they go out - They don't want a percentage of my COMPANY to provide a killer service ( no % of sales model ) - They are under priced and over deliver - They under sell and overdeliver I have tried SO many tools!! Guesty and Tokeet were so glitchy they cost me money to try to setup. Guesty wanted $1000 just to set me up AND a PERCENTAGE OF MY COMPANY ( % of gross sales ) STAY AWAY from any company like that! Wheelhouse automated my prices, for a PERCENTAGE OF MY COMPANY - meh. Guesty promised to scale my ads and failed miserably. Tokeet's chat feature was garbage, but import/export listing feature was awesome. In the end, you can only hook up one channel manager to your airbnb account, so if your like me, you have got to decide on one at a time. I have tried 8 and reviewed 50-60... and Im done looking. SmartBNB delivered in almost every way I could have wanted. - Dirt cheap for what you get - Perfect communications channel w guests ( I am super picky ) - Seamless automated messages WITH THE ABILITY TO REVIEW THEM BEFORE THEY GO OUT - Bad Review strategies and are automated, rational, and effective - Almost instant, and intelligent customer service - Killer Documentation that actually trains you and almost never confuses you - Phenomenal - like off the charts phenomenal customer service tools.
改善点: - The calendar viewing is weak. Its fine because you can just use Airbnbs... but to improve it guys: clicking to go to the next month? Really? You cant scroll to Jan 15th to feb 15th? Fix that. Make it scroll like airbnbs please immediately. I don't touch that, but again, its not really a point against the company because you don't actually need to use it, I can get everything from the airbnb cal with info imported via Ical from the other sites.

タイトル: Lack of Customer Service Overshadows the Product

タイトル: Best PMS on the market and can't wait for their growth.

タイトル: I absolutely love this company and their software
投稿者: Shevi イスラエルのproperty management ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "I absolutely love this company and their software"
良い点: *Very friendly and easy to use. Intuitive, simple and clear. great features: *scheduled messages before, after and during stay *automatic revives. *cleaver coding - identifies the topic of people's questions and replays with a prepared answer. * Fantastic statistical tools displaying data about performance, revenue, conversations with guests etc. *You have the option for automatic replay in multiple languages - based on the guests language. *full control over how much of the software you want involved in your work. *Very affordable, and definitely worth my money. *superb customer service.
改善点: I honestly love the software, have no complains. they used to send automatic daily updates about the ranking of the listing, which was a very helpful tool. You can still access the information now, but you need to get into the app and request for it and it's not automatic anymore. It's not a real problem, but I liked the automatic updates much more.

タイトル: Sehr gute Gästebenachrichtigung und guter Support
投稿者: Peter ドイツのManager ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Sehr gute Gästebenachrichtigung und guter Support"
良い点: Der Funktionsumfang dieser Software, die auch ständig weiterentwickelt wird, hat mich überzeugt. Am meisten nutze ich die automatiserten Benachrichtigungen an die Gäste, die keine Wünsche offen lassen. Meine Gäste schreiben mir überschwängliche Bewertungen bei AirBnB, vor allem über meine schnellen Rückmeldungen, die zum großen Teil automatisierte Nachrichten sind. Sehr positiv ist auch der direkte Draht über eine Chatfunktion zum Support, wo man Tag und Nacht Antworten auf seine Fragen und die notwendige Hilfestellung erhält. Ich habe auch schon mehrere Verbesserungen angeregt, die innerhalb weniger Tage und Wochen umgesetzt wurden und damit allen Nutzern zur Verfügung standen.
改善点: Die Benutzeroberfläche der Software ist selbst nach dem letzten großen Release immer noch wenig ansprechend. Die Menüstruktur und die englischen Menüberschriften sind gewöhnungsbedürftig und nicht intuitiv. Andere Sprachen außer Englisch sind wohl vorgesehen aber m.W. zur Zeit noch nicht erhältlich. Die Kalenderübersicht ist ein langer Balken, der je nach Bildschirmgröße noch nicht einmal einen Monat anzeigt (bei Handys noch viel weniger). Hier muss dringend nachgebessert werden. Dennoch sind das Kleinigkeiten bei einem ansonssten hervorragenden Produkt.
